propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is falsy and require_authenticated is off, allowing unsigned writes to go undetected
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide with no per-env breakdown, making per-env signing failures invisible behind other envs
AC2: fsck must report as a counted issue any env_id with zero signed events or all Unknown-authored events that wrote at or after the store's first signed event, excluding dormant pre-signing envs

AC3: _apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is skipped due to missing resolvable identity or missing signing_key, naming the event uuid and ticket, while remaining best-effort (no writes may fail)
Held-out tests must verify AC2 catches active unsigned envs while excluding dormant pre-signing envs, and AC3 logs the skip path without failing the write
